items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: If my bass hadn't of broke, I'd of sounded a lot more like Scott Lafaro than Scott Lafaro did.

ctx.x: But it might come from some little cat like Lafaro was. Scott Lafaro used to come to my job at the Showplace, put his feet up on a chair and go to sleep, every night. Matter of fact, the date I did with you, --
